title: GC pressure: pooled MeshVolume, cave-generation scratch buffers, span-based uploads, low-latency GC
player_outcome: Fewer periodic whole-game freezes from garbage collection, especially while exploring new ground.
design: Checked in code, and found a larger source than the audit listed: every mesh job builds a new MeshVolume that allocates three bool[262144] arrays (Opaque, Snap, CrispCell), about 786 KB of large-object heap per job (MeshVolume.cs:19-21). CaveGenerationPass.Dense allocates up to three float[39304] (157 KB each, also LOH) per chunk (CaveGenerationPass.cs:201-206). MeshUpload.Build copies every vertex stream with ToArray.

MeshVolume: add a [ThreadStatic] pooled instance with Reset(nb, tables, light); ChunkMesher uses MeshVolume.Rent(...). Its consumers (SurfaceNets, CellMesher, LiquidMesher, GrassScatter) only read it during the build.

CaveGenerationPass: [ThreadStatic] float[ChunkGenContext.Volume] scratch buffers for spagA, spagB and cheese; keep the null semantics for cheese. Output must be identical: golden hashes unchanged in the same commit.

MeshUpload.Build: pass streams with Variant.CreateFrom(span) (positions, normals, colors, indices) and MemoryMarshal.AsBytes spans for Custom0 and Custom1, removing the Custom0Bytes/Custom1Bytes copies. Keep the ToArray path as a fallback if an overload is missing in GodotSharp 4.7.

GC mode: set GCSettings.LatencyMode = SustainedLowLatency while a world runs (WorldLauncher.Launch) and restore Interactive in WorldRuntime._ExitTree. Strata.csproj: <ConcurrentGarbageCollection>true</ConcurrentGarbageCollection> and <TieredPGO>true</TieredPGO>.
Small per-frame LINQ: ChunkRenderer.ShownTriangles becomes a maintained counter; DynamicLights.Assign uses a reusable candidate list with manual nearest-k selection instead of OrderBy/Take/ToList.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Meshing/MeshSurface.cs — span accessors for custom streams
game/World/WorldRuntime.cs — restore GC mode on exit
files_add: tests/Strata.Core.Tests/Meshing/AllocationTests.cs — allocation regression tests for meshing and cave generation
tests: AllocationTests.MeshingReusesVolumeBuffers: the second ChunkMesher.Build of an air-bordered chunk allocates < 200 KB (today ≥ 786 KB)
AllocationTests.CaveGenerationReusesScratch: the second Generate of a deep cave chunk allocates < 400 KB
WorldGenTests golden hashes unchanged; MeshingTests unchanged
verification: Rendering perf.cmds run: perf.gc2 and perf.gc_pause_ms clearly below the P1b-05 baseline over the same script
F3 GC line: gen2 rarely increments while walking
risks: The Variant.CreateFrom(Span<T>) overload set must be checked against GodotSharp 4.7.2 (keep the fallback)
SustainedLowLatency raises memory use somewhat; watch F3 managed MB
DynamicLights.cs is also edited by P1a (torch light energy and range): sequence or merge carefully
